page.layout: One page of text, one column, full width. No margin notes. At the top, the running head "DE PHYSICA." with the page number 339 at the right. At the foot, the gathering signature "y 2".

main_text.p: Ein Zimmetrindbaum: Sambucus, ein holderbaum; Cassia, ein baum in Indien; Colyrus, ein Haselnuß-baum.

head.i: Tantum de Arboribus: sequitur de fruticibus?

main_text.p: Frutices: ut, Libanotis, vulgo Rosmarinus: Oxyacantha, vulgo Berberis. Rosa, ein Rosenstaud: Rubus, ein Brombeerstaudt: Poterion sive uva crispa, Stachelbeere[?]: Coluthea, ein Genesstaud[?].

head.i: Hæc de fruticibus: sequuntur Herbæ alimentariæ.

main_text.p: Herbæ alimentariæ: ut, Triticum, weiz: Hordeū, Gerst: Siligo, Rocken: Avena, Haber: MiliuHirs: Oryza, Reis: Lens, Linse: Pisum, Erbs: Faba, Bohnen: Brassica, Kolkraut: Spinacea, Spinatkraut: Lactuca. Lattich: Beta, Mangold: Cepa, Zwibel: Porrum, Lauch: Petroselinum, Peterlin.

head.i: Tantum de herbis alimentariis: sequuntur minus alimentariæ.

main_text.p: Minus alimentariæ: ut, Viola, Violen: Herba trinitatis, Dreyfaltigkeitkraut: Bellis, Maßlieben: Flos caryophyllorum: Majorana, alias Samsuchus, item amaracus: Nardus indica, sive spica Nardi: Nardus Germanica, vulgo Lavandula: Narcissus.

head.i: Hæc de herbis minus alimentariis: sequitur de medicamentosis.

main_text.p: Herbæ medicamentosæ: ut, crocus, saffran: zinziber, Ingber[?]: zedoaria, Iedwer[?]: galanga, galgen: calamus aromaticus, &c.
Hucusq; de substantia corporea animata mixta ve-getante: sequitur sentiens.

page.notes: Black letter words (German) are marked with bl. Doubtful readings: "Stachelbeere", "Genesstaud", "Ingber" and "Iedwer" are uncertain in the scan and are marked [?]. "Miliu" may carry a macron over the u (Miliū); the scan is unclear. "Hordeū" keeps the printed tilde. The head lines are centred italic and are set at level 2 as passage titles. No catchword is printed.
